title: Encoding report
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 12.5 Size at each stage; QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL.

statements.label: Encoding report
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL return an EncodingReport with the size at every stage (CBOR, COSE, deflated, HC1 characters) and the QR version and error-correction level. It SHALL add a warning when the HC1 length is over a configurable threshold, pointing to VHL as the alternative.

sources.quote: a payload that grows much beyond this belongs behind a VHL instead
